name: Horse_Ride_Trot
notes: posting (rising) trot: rise with diagonal FR+HL (frames 0-10), sit on FL+HR (11-22); one rise per stride

name: Horse_Ride_Rear
notes: hands stay on the rein grips at the base of the neck (fists closed = grabbing the mane), torso folds onto the neck

name: Horse_Ride_Graze
notes: loose reins: the horse's head is down (rein grips move ~0.25 m forward/down); the hands rest low on the withers. The rein grips are out of reach here: IK the reins' rein_grip bones to the rider's palms in game.

name: Horse_Ride_Drink
notes: loose reins: the horse's head is down (rein grips move ~0.25 m forward/down); the hands rest low on the withers. The rein grips are out of reach here: IK the reins' rein_grip bones to the rider's palms in game.

name: Horse_Ride_Mount_L
notes: horse at rest (play with Idle); root bone travels from the stand point (horse-root space) to the horse root; ends on Horse_Ride_Idle frame 0

name: Horse_Ride_Mount_R
notes: horse at rest (play with Idle); root bone travels from the stand point (horse-root space) to the horse root; ends on Horse_Ride_Idle frame 0

name: Horse_Ride_Dismount_L
notes: horse at rest; root bone travels from the horse root to the ground stand point (root motion); ends standing, facing forward

name: Horse_Ride_Dismount_R
notes: horse at rest; root bone travels from the horse root to the ground stand point (root motion); ends standing, facing forward

name: Horse_Ride_Dismount_Jump
notes: horse at rest; vaults off to the left (both hands on the withers), lands in a crouch; root bone -> ground point

name: Horse_Ride_FallOff
notes: rider catapulted forward-right by the buck, lands on his back beside the horse (head away from it). root stays at the clip origin: the rider's world pose = horse root * D(t) * clip; after the clip re-parent the rider to the ground at end_ground_point (horse-root space)

name: Horse_Ride_Death
notes: horse collapses onto its right side; the rider jumps clear to the left, lands in a crouch and kneels facing the horse. root stays at the clip origin (world = horse root * D(t) * clip); re-parent to the ground at end_ground_point

name: Horse_Ride_Spur
notes: legs carry the aid (heels squeeze twice): play full-body (idle / walk) or upper_bones only for the forward lean

name: Horse_Ride_Sword_Swing_L
notes: starts/ends on Horse_Ride_Sword_Idle; reins in the left hand; blade = thumb direction

name: Horse_Ride_Sword_Swing_R
notes: starts/ends on Horse_Ride_Sword_Idle; reins in the left hand; blade = thumb direction

name: Horse_Ride_Bow_Draw
notes: aim 70 deg to the left of forward, slightly up; ends on Horse_Ride_Bow_Aim frame 0
